histogram_semantics.generation_lag: Actual generation stamp minus scheduled slot; source-update samples.
histogram_semantics.arrival_age: Verified receipt time minus actual generation stamp; delivered-recipient samples, includes the application/transport path.
histogram_semantics.scheduled_arrival_age: Verified receipt time minus scheduled slot; delivered-recipient samples, includes generation lag.
histogram_semantics.percentiles: p50_upper_ms and p99_upper_ms are power-of-two nanosecond-bucket upper bounds, not exact quantiles. max_ms is recorded maximum; bucket counts are not in receipts.

limits: Fixed four-case 50/250/250/50 order is a diagnostic sensitivity pilot, not a failure-rate estimate, repeated-baseline median, server speedup, or ordinary performance/CPU-efficiency ranking.
The 250 us change increases the receive fairness target fivefold; it is not a hard turn-time cap. Both clients are untraced canonical-B variants; the UDP/thread observer still perturbs the runs.
Failed attempt has no measured gate: measurement is null, generated counts/lag/arrival histograms and comparable measured CPU are unknown. Partial gate process snapshots are preserved separately.
Gate rows have no wall/monotonic marker, so exact offer/drain/cleanup boundaries cannot be reconstructed from the observer timestamps.

UDP deltas require the same PID/owned-inode set/socket count. Onset is sample-bounded, not an exact loss timestamp. Observer outer wall timestamps and collection completion bound warning comparison, assuming no unobserved clock step.

Per-TID CPU/schedstat samples cannot identify endpoint futures; disabled schedstats makes zero runnable-wait counters uninformative. Actual sample gaps and collector elapsed quantify observer scheduling/cost limits.

Derived recipes inherit historical non-argument fields from the original receipt, including its old server hash/events/measurement. Those fields are not execution evidence; recipe args/client hash and actual receipts identify each pilot run.
Passing with actual generated work verified does not imply every planned update was generated. All shortfalls and histograms are retained, including one candidate fanout update not generated.
This pilot does not establish a production adoption or reliability fix. The selected root f181 server image and protected source/artifacts remain unchanged.
